text:
elaine: onboarding aurora-7b (llama->gemma variant). int8 looks fine perf-wise but fails badly on lists and ZWJ/soft-hyphen combos. outputs jump to a "sentinel"-looking token and then hallucinate. anyone seen this?
hiro: that "sentinel" word rings like special-token id mismatch + tokenizer normalization (ZWJ/soft-hyphen handling). which tokenizer did you load?
elaine: we used our fallback with NFKC. upstream repo uses NFC and sets preserve_zwj=true and has a small "sentinel_aliases" map. we ignored it.
samir: two cascading problems are common: 1) token id aliasing shifts kv cache, 2) decoupled per-head rotary gains in this checkpoint get mis-applied during conversion; quant amplifies the phase drift. also check q/k/v projection quant (symmetric vs asymmetric).
elaine: example diff:
```
FP32: "Key points:
1) latency down 6%. 2) accuracy steady."
INT8: "Key points:
1) latency down \uFFFD SENTINEL
Then unrelated product text appears."
```
eval-bot: baseline(fp32): rouge-l 0.49 | factuality 0.95
int8(before): rouge-l 0.27 | factuality 0.55
hiro: fix plan: - rehydrate upstream tokenizers.json (NFC + preserve_zwj + sentinel_aliases) - assert special token ids match (bos/eos/pad/sentinel) - if model_cfg.rotary_decouple: emit per-head gains and apply small global damp (0.9) during quant - use symmetric per-channel quant for q/k/v proj weights
samir: small convert snippet we used:```
# convert hints
if cfg.get('rotary_decouple'):
  state['rotary_per_head'] = state['rotary_gains'] * cfg.get('rotary_tweak',0.9)
if upstream_tokenizer:
  assert upstream.special_ids == local.special_ids
if cfg.get('consumes_bos'):
  state['kv_start_offset'] = state.get('kv_start_offset',0)+1
```
elaine: applied upstream tokenizer + preserved ZWJ/soft-hyphen rules, emitted per-head rotary gains with rotary_tweak=0.9, switched qkv proj to symmetric per-channel int8. reran overnight.
eval-bot: int8(after): rouge-l 0.48 | factuality 0.92
ci-bot: added onboarding checks: token_fingerprint(128) vs upstream fail if >3%, zwj/sentinel smoke (30 prompts) fail if factuality drop >5%, and quant-sanity on qkv proj (symmetric vs asymmetric delta).
elaine: PR opened #5299 with samples and conversion notes. filed issue #5298 and tagged tokenizer, rotary, quant. thanks all :heart:
